description: This PHP source file defines the ViewFavorites class, which extends SugarView to generate and display the user's favorite records in the SuiteCRM application. It includes configuration for display options and retrieves user favorites to assign them to a template for rendering.

classes.description: A view class to show user favorites, inheriting from SugarView.
